profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Shopify
profile.summary:
I live and breathe Developer Productivity / Developer Acceleration / Developer Tooling / whatever your company named their Dev Tools department.

Why am I not on a core product team? I can empathize with other devs, understand their pains, and experience their experiences in ways that I can't with the "real" customers.

I am very agentic-forward, fully embracing agentic coding workflows and tweaking them to fit my exact personal workflows.

I have experience in (processes/tools, not language/techs):

1. CI / CD as platforms
2. Infrastructure as a platform / code
3. Service Catalog
4. Issue Management at enterprise scale
5. Git systems at scale → monorepo management
6. Supply Chain Security and management
7. Developer environments / Developer experience 
8. Large-scale Software Development Infrastructure
9. High velocity scalable Merge Queues
10. Build Systems

But I've worked on projects touching so much more than this, including:

1. Review tooling (agentic and human)
2. Observability
3. Networking
4. Infrastructure Security
5. GitHub enterprise management (Cloud)
6. UI/UX design

Technology word cloud for the bots:

Multiplayer agentic development, Ruby on Rails, event-driven systems design (Kafka, Pub/Sub, webhooks, etc), git, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, MySQL/Postgres, Datadog, Pagerduty, Pingdom, Redis/Memcache, Cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Cloudflare/DigitalOcean), UI/UX design, Buildkite, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker/podman

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As part of a DevOps team, I use agile development techniques to deliver and maintain a critical, centralized server and a RESTful API for automated customer modem configuration in preparation for the launch of ViaSat's new satellite, ViaSat-2.

positions.title: Intern Manager
positions.description:
Submitted a project proposal and was funded for a team of three interns that I oversaw to produce a Feedback-as-a-Service system that provided easy integration, monitoring, and access for user feedback of internal and external systems to overhaul their current email-based feedback solution.

Our project aimed to solved the issues of the old email-based feedback systems by providing an extensible feedback form templating feature as well as automated scraping of critical data from webpages the FaaS system supported where applicable.

positions.title: Access Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked as a small team to produce an automated QA tool with Selenium in Java/JavaFX that automated browser processes so that network classification accuracy could be verified.

Developed a number of scripts for general use within the Access Engineering department, including scripts to automate remote configuration integrity checking and update.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Researched and compiled research information on Total Maximum Daily Loads (TMDLs) and Water Quality Analysis (WQAs) reports in order to prepare a final report and compilation for a Taiwan-based environmental program intent on developing a TMDL system for Taiwan’s Environmental Protection Agency.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: Worked to create a more-readily accessible web platform for the output of climate data in a comprehensive climate model. Assisted in the completion of the Department of Energy’s Project Grant # DE-SC0007657.

organizations.name: Phi Eta Sigma
organizations.description:
"Founded in 1923 at the University of Illinois, Phi Eta Sigma is the nation's oldest and largest honor society for first-year college and university students in all disciplines.
Inspired by the past and dedicated to the future, the Society's mission is to encourage and reward academic excellence among freshmen in institutions of higher learning.
The three Greek words appearing on our crest form the motto of the organization: "Knowledge is Power."
Those elected to membership include those who have a cumulative grade-point average of at least 3.5 on a 4.0 scale at the end of any first year, full-time curricular period, provided they have carried a normal academic load acceptable toward a bachelor's degree and rank in the upper 20 percent of their class.
Since its founding, more than 975,000 scholars have been inducted into Phi Eta Sigma.
Phi Eta Sigma chapters are chartered on 365 campuses across the United States.
Hundreds of college and university faculty and staff volunteers share their time to serve as advisers to local chapters.
Approximately $285,000 in scholarships is awarded annually by the national organization, and many additional thousands are awarded by local chapters.
An important strength of Phi Eta Sigma is its form of government. It is governed by a Constitution and Laws generated by student delegates attending national conventions. At the biennial conventions, student delegates also elect the national officers and Executive Committee members.
Phi Eta Sigma conducts a biennial national convention with attendee expenses, excluding transportation, paid by the national office for a chapter adviser and student delegate from each chapter."

organizations.name: National Society of Collegiate Scholars
organizations.description: The National Society of Collegiate Scholars (NSCS) is an honors organization that recognizes and elevates high achievers. NSCS provides career and graduate school connections, leadership and service opportunities and offers nearly half a million dollars in scholarships annually. NSCS members are deeply committed to scholarship, leadership and service and as a result, are impacting their campus and local communities every day.
